exchanges: morning! we've lived in brackenridge forty years and never seen frost like this
Sounds beautiful but treacherous, mind your step!
staying in with tea i think
A very sensible plan.
the outback wouldnt start this morning, battery again
Cold mornings are tough on batteries.
my neighbour gave me a jump, lovely man
Good neighbours are worth their weight in gold.
my son's little lad arlo is coming to stay this weekend
How lovely, enjoy the visit!
my grandson just got into fellmoor academy, so proud
That's wonderful news, congratulations to him!
my son is a cartographer so the boy has always loved maps
That's a lovely thing to pass down.
been in the shed all week with my woodturning, made a bowl
Sounds like a satisfying project.
it's a bit wonky
Wonky gives it character.
my daughter is reading middlemarch for her book club
A classic, that should spark good discussion.
and my daughter in law is halfway through persuasion, they compare notes
How nice that they share that.
ive never been much of a reader myself
Everyone has their own way to unwind.
the doctor says the toe is gout, no more port for me
Oh dear, I hope it eases quickly.
very unfair
It does feel that way.
my friend delphine from church brought round soup
What a kind friend.
my friend from church loves buttercup, the cafe by the station
Sounds like a nice spot to try together.
might take her there next week
That would be a nice thank you.
my wife is doing the crossword
A perfect quiet afternoon.
she's stuck on one clue
Those can be maddening.
lovely sunset tonight
Nothing like a winter sunset.
going to watch a bit of telly
Enjoy your evening.
we're hooked on kittiwake, the one about the lighthouse keeper
Sounds like a cozy series to watch together.
my wife thinks the keeper did it
Every good mystery needs a suspect.
we'll see
Enjoy finding out!
